descriptions.mixed-critical-path-v1: The SSH-derived PATH selected a different compiler namespace. The native reserve stopped the probe before an admissible source edit. Its private donor stayed untouched.
descriptions.mixed-critical-path-v2: The first accepted B edit and its fresh follow-up completed but the accounting selected a lean fresh reference that lacked ELF records. The corrected comparison used the pre-existing detailed edit reference, retained that same observation and verified all subsequent observations.
descriptions.mixed-critical-workers-v1: A complete first edit with the original physical Rust incremental tree is retained. A private clone reached its 25 GiB reserve during restoration. That command has no completed output and is excluded.
descriptions.mixed-critical-workers-v2: The new private clone relocated only its Rust incremental files to a second ext4 device. The sorted input size, mtime and content records were identical before and after. All six commands qualified, using the original native input storage.

secondary-mount.scope: Only the private Rust incremental tree is nested-mounted from the other ext4 device, all Cargo receipt rlib/rmeta and live native output/recipe files remain on original volume.
